spans.s:
पौण्डर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A drug, commonly Pūndarīya.
 E. अण् added to पुण्डर्य्य ।

पौण्ड्र m. (-ण्ड्रः)
 1. A country, extending from Rangpur across the
Ganges to the Jungle Mahals and part of south Behar, including
therefore the greater part of

. The Native of that
country.
 3. A king of that country.
 4. A sort of sugar-cane of
a pale straw colour.
 5. Name of the conch-shell of Bhīma.
 E. पुण्ड्र
the same, aff. अण्; also with कन् added पौण्ड्रक ।

पौण्ड्रक m. (-कः)
 1. The pale straw-coloured species of sugar-cane.
2. A man of a mixed caste, from the Vaiśya and female of the
distiller caste, whose business it is to boil sugar.
 E. कन् added
to पौण्ड्र ।

पौण्ड्रवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A country, one of the divisions of central India,
(Behar,)
 E. पौण्ड्र the sugar-cane, and वर्द्धन increasing.

पौण्ड्रिक m. (-कः) A pale straw variety of the sugar-cane.
 E. पुण्ड्र the
same, aff. ठञ् ।
